start: ^As part of our capstone project, I integrated an analytics and quiz system to track and prove if players were actually learning from the game.
^Want me to go into more technical detail?
technical_detail: ^To gather concrete learning data for our client, The Heroes Church, I integrated interactive Bible quizzes, daily quizzes, and NPC-driven trivia directly into the gameplay.
^The system also tracks exactly how much time players spend reading biblical text within the game, packaging all of this data into a clear analytics report for our client.
